subject: Strategic Plan Community Input Plan
overview: The MPS Communications Subcommittee met to review a proposed plan for gathering community feedback regarding the district's strategic plan. The subcommittee approved the framework for conducting community roundtables and distributing a follow-up survey.

items.title: Call to Order and Meeting Announcement
items.summary: Member Jenny Graham called the remote meeting to order, read the governor's executive order regarding remote meetings, and conducted roll call.

items.title: Strategic Plan Community Engagement Plan
items.summary: The subcommittee discussed a draft strategy for hosting community roundtables in April and distributing a follow-up survey to gather public input on the district's mission, vision, and strategic goals. The motion to approve the proposed roundtable plan and survey passed.
